```json
{
  "subtype": "predictive_feature_engineering",
  "focus_variable": "label_pos",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "neg_word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Count of negative lexicon words derived from text; lies outside the label and plausibly correlates with low satisfaction."},
    {"name": "pos_word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Count of positive lexicon words; a legitimate text-derived signal predicting positive sentiment label."},
    {"name": "sentiment_score", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Continuous lexicon-based sentiment; a plausible predictor of label_pos, not a deterministic restatement of it."},
    {"name": "negation_adjusted_sentiment", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Sentiment refined for negation handling; a distinct, plausibly stronger predictive feature of the label."},
    {"name": "complaint_phrase_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Counts explicit complaint phrases in text; carries targeted signal about low satisfaction while remaining outside the label."},
    {"name": "exclamation_ratio", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Stylistic intensity feature; weak but legitimate predictor, not a component of the label."},
    {"name": "caps_ratio", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Proportion of capitalized characters; stylistic emphasis signal, plausibly mildly predictive, not leakage."},
    {"name": "review_length_tokens", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Length is a generic but legitimate covariate that can correlate with satisfaction; weak predictor."},
    {"name": "predicted_low_satisfaction", "role": "leakage", "is_predictor": false, "rationale": "A prediction of the outcome itself; it is a direct proxy/restatement of the focus label and constitutes target leakage."}
  ],
  "n_predictors": 8,
  "predictive_utility": 0.6,
  "rationale": "Most columns are genuine text-derived features (sentiment, negation-adjusted sentiment, complaint counts, positive/negative word counts) that plausibly predict label_pos without restating it, giving real predictive leverage. Several stylistic features (exclamation ratio, caps ratio, length) are weaker and somewhat generic. However 'predicted_low_satisfaction' is target leakage—a direct proxy of the focus—and should be excluded. As a set, the sentiment and complaint features provide solid, non-trivial signal beyond the raw text, warranting a moderately high but not maximal utility."
}
```
